title: NormalizedFinding
description: Normalized security finding produced by any pipeline stage and consumed by the gate.

tool.description: Name of the scanner that produced this finding, e.g. gitleaks, semgrep, trivy, hadolint, checkov, zap

stage.description: Pipeline stage that produced this finding

severity.description: Normalized severity (exactly these four values, this casing)

file.description: Repo-relative path to the affected file

fix.description: Human-readable remediation advice, or null if unavailable

cve_id.description: CVE identifier if applicable, e.g. CVE-2021-23337

cwe.description: CWE identifier if applicable, e.g. CWE-89

installed_version.description: Installed version of the affected package

fixed_version.description: Version in which the vulnerability is fixed

fix_available.description: Whether a fix is available for this finding

help_uri.description: URL with more information about this finding

raw_severity.description: Original severity label from the tool, before normalization

waived.description: Whether this finding has been waived by the gate (set by gate only)

waiver_id.description: ID of the waiver that covers this finding
